questions.q: Which city does Palestine claim as its capital?
questions.why: The government is based in Ramallah.

questions.q: Which two separate areas make up the Palestinian territories?
questions.why: Israel lies between them.

questions.q: Which leader headed the PLO for decades?
questions.why: He shared the 1994 Nobel Peace Prize.

questions.q: Who has been President of the Palestinian Authority since 2005?
questions.why: He is also known as Abu Mazen.

questions.q: Which 1993 agreements created the Palestinian Authority?
questions.why: They were signed at the White House.

questions.q: Which city in the West Bank is the birthplace of Jesus in Christian tradition?
questions.why: The Church of the Nativity is there.

questions.q: Which ancient city is often called the oldest continuously inhabited city?
questions.why: It is near the Dead Sea.

questions.q: What do Palestinians call the 1948 displacement?
questions.why: It means 'catastrophe'.

questions.q: Which uprising began in 1987?
questions.why: It means 'shaking off'.

questions.q: In which year did the UN General Assembly make Palestine a non-member observer state?
questions.why: It was upgraded from an observer entity.

questions.q: Which city holds the Cave of the Patriarchs?
questions.why: It is sacred to Jews and Muslims.

questions.q: Which barrier built by Israel runs through the West Bank?
questions.why: Construction began in 2002.

questions.q: Which UN agency serves Palestinian refugees?
questions.why: It was set up in 1949.

questions.q: Which 1916 deal divided the region between Britain and France?
questions.why: Britain later ruled Palestine under a mandate.

questions.q: Which war began in Gaza in October 2023?
questions.why: It caused a severe humanitarian crisis.

questions.q: Which black-and-white checked scarf is a Palestinian symbol?
questions.why: It became famous worldwide.

questions.q: Which fried chickpea balls are a favourite?
questions.why: They are often eaten in pita.

questions.q: Which salty lake lies on the West Bank's eastern edge?
questions.why: It is the lowest place on land.

questions.q: Which tree and its oil are central to Palestinian farming?
questions.why: The olive harvest is a big event.

questions.q: Which cheese pastry soaked in syrup is famous from Nablus?
questions.why: It is served warm.

questions.q: Which line dance is performed at Palestinian weddings?
questions.why: Dancers stamp in time.

questions.q: Which crop from Jaffa became world famous?
questions.why: They were exported from the 1800s.

questions.q: Which poet is called Palestine's national poet?
questions.why: He wrote 'Identity Card'.

questions.q: Which scholar wrote 'Orientalism'?
questions.why: He was born in Jerusalem.

questions.q: Which chicken and onion dish on taboon bread is the national dish?
questions.why: It uses lots of sumac.

questions.q: Which upside-down rice dish is flipped when served?
questions.why: Its name means 'upside down'.

questions.q: Which embroidery style is on UNESCO's list?
questions.why: Patterns show a woman's village.

questions.q: Which church in Bethlehem is a UNESCO site?
questions.why: It is one of the oldest working churches.

questions.q: Which ancient palace near Jericho has a famous 'Tree of Life' mosaic?
questions.why: It dates from the Umayyad period.

questions.q: Which Palestinian city is famous for olive oil soap?
questions.why: Soap has been made there for centuries.
